```plato
//==
// # IntervalsTransformsDeformable — derived functionality for IDeformable2D/3D
//
// Bodies for the `IDeformable2D` / `IDeformable3D` interfaces declared in
// `transforms.concepts.plato`: translation, scaling, and rotation — about the
// origin or about an arbitrary pivot — all expressed through each type's single
// Deform primitive. The mapping types are concrete, so these build real
// Point2D/Vector2D and Point3D/Vector3D lambdas.

library IntervalsTransformsDeformable
{
    //==
    // IDeformable2D — a value reshaped by an arbitrary Point2D -> Point2D mapping.
    // The mapping type is concrete (Function1<Point2D, Point2D>), so these build
    // real Point2D/Vector2D lambdas.

    // Translate every point by `offset`.
    Translate(self: IDeformable2D, offset: Vector2D): Self
        => self.Deform(p => p + offset);
```
